contents: Displayed yield and shop-floor loss did not agree, so teams prioritized different causes. As assembly-process lead, I aligned denominators and defect names, then coordinated MSA, controlled retests, and cross-team actions. Monthly average good yield reached 98.7% in December 2024 from an initial level of about 40%, followed by SOP, QCP, and P-FMEA updates.
summary: Displayed yield and shop-floor loss did not agree, so teams prioritized different causes. Monthly average good yield reached 98.7% in December 2024 from an initial level of about 40%, followed by SOP, QCP, and P-FMEA updates.
title: 2170 Assembly-Line Good-Yield Stabilization

contents: Individual auto cycles could not prove end-to-end flow, safety, repeatability, or pilot-production readiness. I built acceptance sheets and punch lists, tracked supplier corrections and retests, and managed materials, WIP, lot history, and pilot production. Initial assembly yield was about 95% across roughly 1,000 cells over five days, including reworked cells that met quality criteria.
summary: Individual auto cycles could not prove end-to-end flow, safety, repeatability, or pilot-production readiness. Initial assembly yield was about 95% across roughly 1,000 cells over five days, including reworked cells that met quality criteria.
title: FAT/SAT of 11 Core Machines for an NCM Prismatic Pilot Line

contents: Experience-dependent assembly and inspection created variation in work time and missed checks. While performing overhaul and precision assembly, I documented parts, torque, alignment, leak, and repeatability checks and trained operators. The SOP and checklist were applied in the field; team monthly output increased from 1–2 to 4–5 units during the same period.
summary: Experience-dependent assembly and inspection created variation in work time and missed checks. The SOP and checklist were applied in the field; team monthly output increased from 1–2 to 4–5 units during the same period.
title: Vacuum-Robot Overhaul Standardization

contents: Film cracking and particles recurred within warranty life under repeated high-temperature use. I redesigned film and process conditions, evaluated small, medium, and full-size samples, and established bath-control criteria. The revised condition entered production and was monitored for about a year through the transition period.
summary: Film cracking and particles recurred within warranty life under repeated high-temperature use. The revised condition entered production and was monitored for about a year through the transition period.
title: High-Temperature Anodizing Film Development for OLED Parts

contents: Stable internal results were insufficient when customer measurement methods and acceptance criteria differed. I rebuilt surface-treatment and inspection criteria, including Hi-Pot, acid resistance, and corrosion resistance, and supported same-sample correlation and technical audits. The technical qualification was completed, but the company ended the business about a year later because of the product mix and profitability.
summary: Stable internal results were insufficient when customer measurement methods and acceptance criteria differed. The technical qualification was completed, but the company ended the business about a year later because of the product mix and profitability.
title: AMAT/AKT CVD & PECVD Component Qualification

contents: Roughness, diffusion, and product-reuse risks remained open at lab scale before equipment fabrication proceeded. I evaluated sample-quality and reusability issues and translated the failed scale-up into pre-fabrication gates for later projects. Normal operation was not achieved; the case produced explicit gates for sample quality, reusability, equipment conditions, and stopping criteria.
summary: Roughness, diffusion, and product-reuse risks remained open at lab scale before equipment fabrication proceeded. Normal operation was not achieved; the case produced explicit gates for sample quality, reusability, equipment conditions, and stopping criteria.
title: Diffuser Ultrasonic-Stripping Scale-up Failure and Validation Gates

contents: A model that performed well on public data still had to be checked against field images with different lighting, angles, and surfaces. I reevaluated the model on about 198 field images and compared augmentation, model combinations, and missed-versus-false detections by threshold. Field-image recall initially fell to 15.84%; the ResNet–DeiT combination improved it to 93.07% in the limited evaluation.
summary: A model that performed well on public data still had to be checked against field images with different lighting, angles, and surfaces. Field-image recall initially fell to 15.84%; the ResNet–DeiT combination improved it to 93.07% in the limited evaluation.
title: Building an AI Model to Find Defects in Welding Images

contents: Finding sequence and communication issues only after equipment installation makes tryout expensive. In a ten-person team, I handled communication setup, AI-candidate review, and technical research; ladder and SCADA implementation remain team contributions. The team connected Factory I/O, PLC, SCADA, and OPC UA in one educational demonstration and defined a virtual-commissioning checklist.
summary: Finding sequence and communication issues only after equipment installation makes tryout expensive. The team connected Factory I/O, PLC, SCADA, and OPC UA in one educational demonstration and defined a virtual-commissioning checklist.
title: Testing Equipment Expansion in a Virtual Factory

contents: Separate robot connections from HMI, database, and twin services blur command ownership and current state; JSON rewrites can also break references. I led the system goal, interfaces, and integration sequence, implementing boundaries across Conty JSON, PC-HMI, Robot Controller, MQTT, DB, PLC Bridge, and Web Twin. The public code verifies command, state, history, and read-only Web Twin paths; Omniverse is explicitly a future extension.
summary: Separate robot connections from HMI, database, and twin services blur command ownership and current state; JSON rewrites can also break references. The public code verifies command, state, history, and read-only Web Twin paths; Omniverse is explicitly a future extension.
title: Indy7 Robot Control and Status Monitoring System

contents: Manufacturing, semiconductor, and battery knowledge accumulated with inconsistent terms and links, making evidence retrieval difficult. I structured the Markdown/YAML vault and link-graph index, then built a CLI that synchronizes changed files to ChromaDB and retrieves/reranks candidates. The current public main includes the knowledge vault, link-graph index, and sync/query flow.
summary: Manufacturing, semiconductor, and battery knowledge accumulated with inconsistent terms and links, making evidence retrieval difficult. The current public main includes the knowledge vault, link-graph index, and sync/query flow.
title: HeungTology for Collecting and Searching Manufacturing Knowledge

contents: Running example code once is different from an experiment whose data, settings, and evaluation can be explained and reproduced. I organized learning topics around preprocessing, training, evaluation, and reproducibility, documenting checks needed before manufacturing-data use. The current public main is a README-based archive of learning topics and experiment criteria.
summary: Running example code once is different from an experiment whose data, settings, and evaluation can be explained and reproduced. The current public main is a README-based archive of learning topics and experiment criteria.
title: Deep Learning Model Study Log

contents: Exam answers, theory, and image rights come from different evidence, so fluent AI completion can create incorrect learning material. I linked question, theory, source, rights, and publication state and designed learner flow and regression checks that prevent pre-submission answer leakage. The masterbook publishes only supported items and keeps conflicting or rights-uncertain material on HOLD.
summary: Exam answers, theory, and image rights come from different evidence, so fluent AI completion can create incorrect learning material. The masterbook publishes only supported items and keeps conflicting or rights-uncertain material on HOLD.
title: Study Masterbook for Maintenance Engineer Exam Candidates

contents: Similar questions can produce different outcomes based on separation reason, insured period, documents, and individual notice; a website should not decide eligibility. I classified 165 de-identified questions into eight types and generated official-source links, guides, search pages, and structured data from one source. The operating guide helps users find facts, documents, and official channels rather than issuing personal determinations.
summary: Similar questions can produce different outcomes based on separation reason, insured period, documents, and individual notice; a website should not decide eligibility. The operating guide helps users find facts, documents, and official channels rather than issuing personal determinations.
title: Guidebook for Common Unemployment Benefit Questions

contents: An AI reading data and proposing an action does not prove authority to execute or a safe external result. I combined selected Ontology/LLM Wiki knowledge with execution conditions, then designed evidence review, human approval, allow or block, and result recheck in that order. The local experiment stops work outside the approved scope and checks the state before and after execution.
summary: An AI reading data and proposing an action does not prove authority to execute or a safe external result. The local experiment stops work outside the approved scope and checks the state before and after execution.
title: AI Agent Experiment That Checks Evidence Before Acting
